interactive.reason: Computer Use stopped after Fab opened Firefox, whose URL policy enforcement was unsupported. No further desktop input was issued.

limits: Procedural vehicle approximations and estimated tire/soil coefficients.
Soil and marks persist for the session; no disk persistence. Rendered tiles are capped at 768 and cached soil states at 8192, after which the farthest history may be dropped.
Height-field deformation does not model flowing mud, individual grains, snow temperature or overhangs.
Fab pack downloaded and researched; no Fab library asset has been imported into this build.
No live desktop driving check this round; native input-driven regressions and game-generated captures were used.
Controller hardware, complete route traversal and long-session stability remain unproven.
